newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ZAMORANO SAYS TOP FORM HAS COME AT RIGHT TIME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMORANO SAYS TOP FORM HAS COME AT RIGHT TIME.

text.p: Chilean striker Ivan Zamorano says the five goals he scored for his country in a 6-0 World Cup qualifying win against Venezuela on Tuesday have come at just the right time for his Italian club Internazionale.
In an interview with Italian sports daily Gazzetta Dello Sport, Zamorano said he had hit his best form just when Inter needed him most.

Next Wednesday Inter meet German side Shalke in Gelsenkirchen in the first leg of the UEFA Cup final. In serie A, Inter are involved in a close tussle with Parma for the runners-up spot, and consequent champions' league qualification, with six games to play.
Inter, at home to Vicenza on Saturday, are currently third in serie A on 48 points, one behind second-placed Parma and seven behind leaders Juventus.
"Inter and the Inter fans can rest easy. I haven't used up all my goals against Venezuela, I've still some in the tank for Inter,"Zamorano said.
"Never before had I scored five goals in an official game and just think I also missed a penalty...I'm in form, in terrific form. I can say that, can't I?"
